contribution.position: The test suite is green (412 passed, 87% coverage), but the measured cold_start of 1900ms at peak load is more than double the 800ms performance budget, which is a direct reliability exposure under load. Combined with last quarter's two sev2 retry-storm incidents, the service's behavior at peak is exactly where it has already proven fragile; shipping this week with a known 2.4x budget breach on cold start would widen that fragility rather than close it.
